name: jinshi-gravity
description: Jinshi Gravity - a local multiplayer one-button gravity-switch racing web game. Server-authoritative Colyseus + Phaser 3 client. Standalone phase; Discord/Jinshi integration is future work.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @jinshi-gravity/shared && npm run build -w @jinshi-gravity/server && npm run build -w @jinshi-gravity/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @jinshi-gravity/shared && npm run test -w @jinshi-gravity/shared && npm run test -w @jinshi-gravity/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @jinshi-gravity/shared && npm run typecheck -w @jinshi-gravity/server && npm run typecheck -w @jinshi-gravity/client
